name: Josias
bio:
Hello! My name is Josias Fong and I am one of the community service managers.
I’ve always loved animals and nature, especially spending time with my dogs, running with friends, and hiking on local trails. Being outdoors has made me appreciate nature even more and showed me how important it is to protect it.  Some of my main goals include starting our local clean ups, specifically around the creek to help reduce the amount of trash and litter in those areas. I hope that through our work we can have a positive impact and encourage our community members to join in on the cause! I believe that protecting our environment starts with appreciating it, and I hope we can help people appreciate it more so they will be encouraged to live a more sustainable lifestyle.
